★ Request
Show Jungle Pocket (Summer Uniform)

■ Stage Direction
Due to the animation where Jungle Pocket pulls out the roster, please leave about a 1-second pause after "Hey, Trainer!"

■ Stage Direction
Please play the voices in series (one after another)

■ Stage Direction
Age: 3rd year middle school (one year younger than Jungle Pocket)
Personality: Show-off / energetic

■ Stage Direction
Please play the voices in parallel (at the same time)

■ Stage Direction
Please play the voices in parallel (at the same time)

★ Request
Generic Wipe

(At this timing, return Jungle Pocket to her default center position)

■ Stage Direction
For "—Right!?" on line 2, please deliver it slightly louder, with more forceful presence than a low snarl.

■ Stage Direction
1 second silence at start

You should've said something sooner! —Oi, guys!
We're helpin' this one out with their work!!!

Oi, oi, what're you talkin' about?
I ain't their boss. I'm their partner, get it?

The truth is, I have paperwork that must be wrapped up by the end of the day.
So when I ask her to let me focus on my work for a bit—

Hehe... Lucky you, getting help from the Boss.
You'd better show Pokke-san some gratitude, alright?

Y-Yes, ma'am! I'm so sorry!
Just watch how hard I work from here on out!

Hey, guys? You're helping out too, obviously, right?
Nobody's got a problem with that, DO YA!?

Don't let me down, got it?
...Huh?!

Heh-heh, that's my partner!
Alright, let's start with "Gods of Laughter"!

Hah? You wanna focus?
What's your deal... Are you really—

Oh-!
What took ya so long?

Don't hold back! We're partners, ain't we?
When things get hairy, lean on me.

Course we will!
Orders from the Boss are absolute!

'Sup! Pardon the intrusion.
Good work today, Trainer!

So you played games instead? Huh?
Is that all you gotta say for yourself?

...To be honest, I just wanted them to leave the room,
but the atmosphere made it impossible to say...

Well, deep down, they're good kids!
Alright, let's wrap this up quick!

Ah... S-Sorry, Pokke-san!
I don't really get how to gather this info...!

AHAHAHA! Right?! This guy is crazy good! I love him,
so much! Even in his solo shows, his material is razor-sharp—

—Right.
Heh-heh, long as you get it!
Hey, you guys too! Don't you dare slack off, got it?

We all figured we'd watch some comedy together!
Can we borrow this place? Nowhere else had enough space.

Distracted by Jungle Pocket and the others' laughter, my hands
stop typing on the PC. ...I can't concentrate like this.

Hey, partner.
If anything else comes up, tell me right away, got it?

I nodded—wishing that I could soon become an adult
worthy of being called her "partner."

You're researching the Umamusume I'm racing next... right?
...Ah, ask the Trainer for the fine details!
Ah... Ugh... S-Sorry...

A dozen or so minutes after wrapping up training with Jungle Pocket.
Upon returning to the Trainer's Office—

Yes Boss!
Right away, Boss!!
Ahaha... Hm? You wanna watch too, Trainer?
Alright, let's get down to business!
...Hey. What the hell do you think you're doing?

Bwahaha! Holy crap... haha!
Isn't this comedian way too hilarious?!

Alright, let's split up the tasks!
You two, gather materials on the area around Tokyo Racecourse!

And so, thanks to everyone's help, research went smoothly—
and I somehow managed to finish the work.

Hey, Trainer! Look! You can use this, right?!
See, I put in the work! ...Hm?
